fill_rules.sports_fixture: Pick a real fixture from the competition's official schedule on 7 Nov. It must end between 8 Nov 12:00 UTC and 10 Nov 12:00 UTC. resolve_after = scheduled start + 4 h. fill_rules.news_event: Pick one official, date-certain event between 8 and 10 Nov 2026 with a public result (central bank decision, official statistics release, scheduled launch). Write it as YES/NO naming the source; <= 280 chars. resolve_after = announced time + 4 h.
